answer: Latency-Locked Basalt Timing. Each identity must embed a hardware pulse generator sealed in a basalt matrix; its decay curve is read as a crystal clock signature. Enrollment requires continuously submitting these readings faster than any single operator can simulate cheaply, since the matrix tolerates one unique microsecond pattern per physical unit. Faking N identities costs N fabricated devices plus N physical timing channels running in real time, which cannot be parallelized on one machine.
